gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i1: Verifies that {@link SparseBloomFilter#merge(Hasher)} rejects hashers that produce indices outside the valid range {@code [0, numberOfBits)}.

The filter shap
ADDED i2: Shape shared by all tests: 17 hash functions, 72-bit filter.
ADDED i3: A {@link Hasher} that always produces a single, fixed index regardless of the shape — used to inject out-of-range values into a filter under test.
ADDED i4: Merging a hasher whose index equals {@code numberOfBits} (one past the last valid bit) must throw {@link IllegalArgumentException}.
ADDED i5: valid range is [0, numberOfBits-1]
ADDED i6: Merging a hasher whose index is {@code -1} (below zero) must throw {@link IllegalArgumentException}.
